messages:
Olivia: quick sync — we've discovered a gap: KeyRotate events emitted by the auto-rotation service don't include an actor/principal, so customers can't attribute who initiated the rotation.
Ajay: can you paste a sample event we observed?
Olivia: ```
{ "event": "KeyRotate", "key_id": "kms-prod-42", "timestamp": "2026-02-18T21:12:03Z", "meta": { "rotation_type": "auto" } }
```
no actor field, so downstream audit replay can't tell svc vs human.
Dmitri: that's a compliance issue. customers expect a principal field. proposal: add `principal` and `actor_type` plus `request_id` and `source` (api/console/scheduler).
Maria: agree. also for RBAC deltas (role.grant / role.revoke) include a minimal `delta` with before/after or at least the changed attributes so SOC teams can verify intent.
Sam: timeline/compatibility question: this is a schema bump. older consumers should ignore extra fields but we must version and provide a migration path.
Olivia: initial proposal: bump event schema minor version to 2.1 and add canonical fields: principal, actor_type, request_id, source, delta, sensitivity. add `schema_version` and `compatibility": \"backward\"` on emitted events.
Dmitri: during transition emit both old and new fields for a period (e.g., 90 days). add CI enforcement so any code path that mutates RBAC or triggers KMS rotations calls the central audit helper lib.
Ajay: infra action: create central audit helper under eng-platform; security owns the spec, platform owns the helper implementation. PR template will require an `audit-impact` tag.
Maria: customer-facing validation: build a lightweight CLI/harness (python) customers can run against their audit sink to validate required keys and retention policy. platform can bundle this with exporters.
Olivia: privacy note: `principal` should be an opaque id (user_id/service_id) — do NOT include email. we can add `principal_pseudonym` for optional display mapping.
Ajay: RBAC delta example for docs: ```
{ "event": "role.grant", "schema_version": "2.1", "principal": "svc-rotator-01", "actor_type": "service", "delta": { "role": "secret-reader", "change": "grant" }, "request_id": "req-abc123" }
```
Maria: propose `sensitivity` enum [none, low, high] to tag events touching secrets so customers can apply retention filters.
Sam: draft rollout plan: week 0 spec PR + CI hook rejecting missing fields in new code; weeks 1-2 emit both old and new fields and annotate `schema_version`; week 3 run internal validation harness across sinks; week 6 publish customer notice and docs; week 12 remove deprecated shim after 90-day window. also add rollout dashboard metric `audit-schema:v2.1` adoption rate.
security-bot: policy-check: any audit schema change must include migration plan, retention implications, and a customer-facing changelog entry. see https://go.redwood/audit-schema-policy.
Olivia: KMS-specific: when a key is wrapped/unwrapped during rotation we should also emit `key_access` events with `wrapped_by_key_id` and `service_name` so BYOK customers can prove usage.
Dmitri: note on PII again — keep principal opaque. add `actor_type` values like [human, service, automation] to help retention/alert rules.
Ajay: I'll open the infra ticket for the helper + lint rule and tag @platform @legal for privacy sign-off.
Maria: I'll draft the docs and the sample event payloads for the customer changelog. will coordinate with privacy review before publishing sample events.
Sam: filing RFC now and will paste links here.
Olivia: can someone drop the RFC and PR in this thread when created?
Sam: RFC: https://go.redwood/rfcs/1291 — PR coming.
Olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
